Focus Crypto Coins ETF - Bullish Flag Below 4x ATR% from 50-MA

I like that the crypto spots have setup itself early into the market week, and right at the back of a pullback in equities index to ascertain their relative strength. Aside from $SOLUSD that's above 4x ATR% from 50-MA, I have ranked the remaining 3 main crypto coin ETF that I will be prioritizing at the open post 30mins later for ORH.

Stalk $SOXX via $SOXL 3x Long (Bullish Flag)

One of the dominant themes across the strongest industry groups is semiconductors, represented across $SMH $XSD $SOXX $ROBO $BOTZ separately. $SOXL presents the highest ADR% and most liquid opportunity for direct ETF exposure.

Current price print still remain loose within a sideway box range with latest print 3.1% wide against 2.2% ADR in $SOXX. Would prefer further consolidation while rising 10 and 20-MA continues to inch towards price.
very rarely. probably EP but mostly failed that's why I prefer delayed PEG for better tisk control

Focus $ASTS via $ASTX 2x Long (Pre-Market Gapper)

$NASA is one of the group that is holding up well, with 1-month RS% at 80%. $ASTS over here display ascending triangle pattern with latest 2 weeks of higher swing low action trading within the coiling of 10, 20 and 50-MA. Pre-market volume now only 500k, so we shall continue to monitor for RVOL. looking for at least 25% RVOL within 30mins of open to deem as high volume run rate day

Stalk $AXTI via $AXTX 2 x long (Sideway Box Range)

Broke out of downtrend line but price has stalled and has been building sideway and hovering just beneath 100-MA (purple). 17.6% ADR on $AXTX, hard to ignore this idea. Need another tighten price action for me to Focus

Stalk $BE via $BEX 2x Long (Another sequential higher lows)

Continue to build higher lows after immediate fill of Sept 24th gap down. Price has been poking $283-$286 since Sept 8th. Very clean relative strength name but range remain loose at the moment even with volume contracting. Would prefer at least 2 tighten price print before Focus

not today for me with print already crossing 70% of ATR for $ETHUSD and $XRPUSD. Even if BTCUSD ORH, it will also exceed 70%. 

No longer a low risk entry spot to magnify your reward based on its intraday implied volatility

33% RVOL now but wrong side of the price print. still within ascending triangle so will still keep as a Stalk name. I don't remove name from focus/stalk unless they violate/breakdown the technical structure violently in price print
